subject.title: fix(codex): preserve native subagent results after parent cleanup

question: Should PR #102060 be the canonical landing path for #97593 instead of the narrower open retry-cap PR #97715?
rationale: Both PRs address the same unbounded native subagent delivery loop, but this branch also changes parent cleanup and app-server-history recovery behavior, so automation should not choose the product and upgrade-risk boundary alone.

options.title: Select This Broader Branch
options.body: Use #102060 as the canonical fix if maintainers want the retry cap plus detached-child recovery and shared-client lifecycle changes together.

options.title: Land A Narrower Retry Cap
options.body: Use #97715 or another smaller branch if maintainers want only the bounded retry behavior before broader monitor recovery changes.

options.title: Pause Both For A Different Policy
options.body: Hold both PRs if maintainers want a different delivery deadline, retry count, or failed-state policy before changing runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Select This Broader Branch
recommendation.body: Use #102060 as the canonical fix if maintainers want the retry cap plus detached-child recovery and shared-client lifecycle changes together.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent merged work on Codex native subagent completion and recovery surfaces.
